description: Angular component for a timeseries table widget in the Thingsboard platform, including data source management, styling, and user interactions.

classes.name: TimeseriesTableWidgetComponent
classes.description: Angular component implementing a timeseries data table with sorting, pagination, and styling features.

classes.name: TimeseriesDatasource
classes.description: Data source class managing data fetching, transformation, and state for the timeseries table.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the widget, sets up subscriptions, and prepares data sources.

methods.name: ngOnDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up subscriptions and observers on component destruction.

methods.name: ngAfterViewInit
methods.description: Sets up reactive form controls and subscriptions after view initialization.

methods.name: onDataUpdated
methods.description: Updates data in the table when new data arrives.

methods.name: onLatestDataUpdated
methods.description: Updates latest data in the table.

methods.name: onEditModeChanged
methods.description: Handles UI changes when edit mode toggles.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Sets default widget settings, actions, and styles.

methods.name: updateDatasources
methods.description: Prepares and sorts data sources for display.

methods.name: editColumnsToDisplay
methods.description: Opens overlay to modify visible columns.

methods.name: prepareHeader
methods.description: Generates header configuration for data columns.

methods.name: updateActiveEntityInfo
methods.description: Updates information about the active entity based on current data source.

methods.name: initSubscriptionsToSortAndPaginator
methods.description: Sets up reactive subscriptions for sorting and pagination controls.

methods.name: onSourceIndexChanged
methods.description: Handles changes in selected data source.

methods.name: enterFilterMode
methods.description: Enables text search filter input.

methods.name: exitFilterMode
methods.description: Disables text search filter input.

methods.name: updateData
methods.description: Fetches and updates data based on current sort and pagination.

methods.name: trackByColumnIndex
methods.description: Track function for Angular to optimize column rendering.

methods.name: trackByRowTimestamp
methods.description: Track function for Angular to optimize row rendering.

methods.name: trackByActionCellDescriptionId
methods.description: Track function for action descriptors.

methods.name: trackBySourcesIndex
methods.description: Track function for data source items.

methods.name: rowStyle
methods.description: Computes style for a row based on style functions.

methods.name: cellStyle
methods.description: Computes style for a cell based on style functions.

methods.name: cellContent
methods.description: Generates cell content, including formatted timestamps and custom content functions.

methods.name: onRowClick
methods.description: Handles row click actions.

methods.name: onActionButtonClick
methods.description: Handles action button clicks within rows.

methods.name: isActiveTab
methods.description: Checks if a tab is active.

methods.name: updateCurrentSourceAllData
methods.description: Updates all data for the current source.

methods.name: updateCurrentSourceData
methods.description: Updates data for the current source.

methods.name: updateCurrentSourceLatestData
methods.description: Updates latest data for the current source.

methods.name: loadCurrentSourceRow
methods.description: Loads rows for the current data source.

methods.name: clearCache
methods.description: Clears cached cell and row styles and content.
